name: Melos
summary: A Dart and Flutter monorepo management tool for repositories containing multiple packages.
advantages: Provides workspace-wide scripts and package filtering
Supports monorepo workflows and automated versioning
Complements Dart pub workspaces with higher-level orchestration
tradeoffs: Adds another development tool and configuration layer
Can be unnecessary for a single-package app or a very small workspace
recommendedFor: Teams that need workspace-wide scripts, package filtering, bootstrapping, or release automation
Large repositories that need orchestration beyond pub workspaces

verification.reason: Current pub.dev metadata and official Melos documentation are sufficient.
